renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Know two states well, then rest in the middle between them — leave both behind at once, and the real shines there. Drop every state you were holding, fence the mind in till it goes nowhere else — and in that middle, your seeing grows wide, wider than wide.

Picture the whole body as made of knowing, or the whole world as fancy, held whole — mind in one piece, and the highest rising. Or feel the two winds crash at their edge, inside or out — the even-minded knower rises, himself the bowl.

Fill the world or your own body with your own bliss and remember it — all at once, drink your own nectar, full of highest bliss. With a trick, with a true try, great bliss shows up on the spot — and through it the real shines. Tie all the channels shut and let the up-breath power crawl slow as an ant — happiness spreads everywhere.

Throw a happiness-made mind between fire and poison — filled with mere wind, or yoked by bliss-remembering. Whatever joy belongs to brahman-as-real is self-told — only that can be told. Licking, churning, pounding to their peak, woman-bliss from fullness, from memory — even with no power in it, a flood of bliss pours out.

paragraphs.text: Learn both states, then post up in the middle — drop both at once and the real lights up. Quit every state, leash the mind till it has nowhere else to go — and in that middle your seeing goes wide, wider than wide.

Call the whole body knowing-stuff, call the world one big fancy, held whole — mind undivided, highest rise unlocked. Or let the two winds collide at the limit, in or out — the evenness-knower rises, himself the bowl.

Soak the world or your body in your own bliss and don't forget it — all at once, your nectar, max bliss. Trick plus true attempt and great bliss drops on the spot — and the real shows through it. Lock every channel, let up-breath crawl ant-speed — happiness spreads wall to wall.

Park a happiness-built mind between fire and poison — wind-filled or memory-yoked. Brahman-real joy is self-told, and that's the only tellable kind. Licking, churning, pounding to the max, fullness-joy from memory — zero power in it and still a bliss-flood.
